page-bg: Page background, scrolls with the page (CSS background shorthand: colours, gradients, url() layers).
page-backdrop: Fixed layer behind everything (skylines, glows); a background value, or none.
page-overlay: Fixed texture over everything (scanlines, grain); a background value, or none.
page-grain: Fixed noise texture over everything; a background value, or none.
text-strong: Emphasised values (numbers in rows, big values).
font-display: Display font: big numbers and values.
font-label: Small label font (meter labels, captions in caps).
font-mono: Monospace font for codes and keys people copy (API keys, setup snippets).
display-shadow: Text-shadow on big numbers and values, or none.
header-border: Header bottom border (border shorthand), or none.
header-tagline: Small decorative line in the header, as a CSS content string ("" for none).
title-color: Page title colour; transparent when title-fill paints the letters.
title-fill: Gradient painted inside the title letters (background-clip: text), or none.
title-shadow: Page title text-shadow (none when title-fill is used).
title-filter: Page title filter (drop-shadows for filled titles), or none.
subtitle-color: Date and "updated" line under the title.
badge-text: Badge before the date (Arcade's "1P"), as a CSS content string ("" for none).
icon-btn-bg: Header icon buttons and date arrows: background.
icon-btn-fg: Header icon buttons and date arrows: icon colour.
icon-btn-border: Header icon buttons and date arrows: border (border shorthand).
icon-btn-radius: Header icon buttons and date arrows: corner radius.
icon-btn-shadow: Header icon buttons and date arrows: box-shadow.
card-shadow: Card box-shadow (outer shadow and inset frame lines).
card-stripe: Image painted as a stripe down the card's left edge, or none.
card-ornament-top: Image painted as a band across the top of the card (e.g. a Greek-key border), or none.
card-ornament-bottom: Image centred on the card's bottom edge (a seal, flourish or grille), or none.
card-corner: Colour of the first corner bracket (transparent for none).
card-corner-2: Colour of the second, opposite corner bracket.
card-corner-size: Length of each corner bracket arm.
card-corner-thickness: Line thickness of the corner brackets.
card-corner-mirror: 1 puts the brackets top-left and bottom-right; -1 puts them top-right and bottom-left.
card-led: Indicator light in the card's top-right corner (a background value), or none.
card-led-shadow: Box-shadow (bezel and glow) of card-led, or none.
card-tag: Text tag in the card's top-right corner (Cyberpunk "SYS//"), as a CSS content string ("" for none).
card-tag-counter: Counter style appended to card-tag (e.g. decimal-leading-zero), or none for no number.
card-tag-color: Colour of card tags (card-tag and swatch tags).
card-title-bg: Card title background (a banner or label bar), or transparent.
card-title-border: Card title border (border shorthand), or none.
card-title-padding: Card title padding (larger when it's a banner).
card-title-box-shadow: Card title box-shadow (banner depth), or none.
card-title-prefix: Text drawn before every card title (Cyberpunk "// "), as a CSS content string ("" for none).
card-title-icon-before: Small image before the card title, or none.
card-title-icon-after: Small image after the card title, or none.
card-title-icon-size: Size of the card title images (0px for none).
card-title-rule: Line under the card title, as a background value (e.g. a gold-leaf gradient), or none.
swatch-1: Background for cards 1, 6, 11… in board order (Color Archive swatches, Alchemist washes); var(--card-bg) when unused.
swatch-1-tag: Tag shown in the top-right corner of swatch-1 cards (e.g. "#E9CF7A"), as a CSS content string ("" for none).
acc: Primary accent (readiness ring, highlights, primary buttons).
acc2: Secondary accent (sleep ring, second chart line).
on-acc: Text colour that reads on acc.
info: Neutral data colour (steps and activity bars).
dim: Very low-emphasis colour (empty states, placeholders, axis labels).
track: Ring track (unfilled part of a ring).
track-2: Second track colour (mood bars, subtle dividers).
divider: Hairline between rows inside a card.
control-clip: Clip-path for buttons, inputs and icon buttons (Cyberpunk's cut corners), or none.
check-today: Outline colour marking today's habit box.
meter-hi: Lit segment near the top of the meter.
meter-pk: Lit segment at the very top of the meter.
meter-glow: Glow size for lit segments (e.g. 4px; 0px for none).
progress-border: Progress bar border (border shorthand), or none.
surface-bg: Drawers, sheets, popovers and panels: background.
surface-fg: Drawers, sheets, popovers and panels: text.
surface-border: Drawers, sheets, popovers and panels: border (border shorthand).
surface-radius: Drawers, sheets, popovers and panels: corner radius.
surface-shadow: Drawers, sheets, popovers and panels: box-shadow.
dock-fg: Phone quick-actions bar text and icons.
dock-border: Phone quick-actions bar top border (border shorthand).
hero-off: Hero gear outline before any progress (dashed).
hero-eyes: Hero eyes once the helm has progress.
hero-eyes-off: Hero eyes before any helm progress.
hero-glow: Soft glow behind the hero figure (a background value), or none.
